summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated Bun bundle in an ESLint config package
details: @ornikar/eslint-config-formatjs 24.0.9 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmods it 0755, and execFileSync's it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, rotated opcode array, `_0xNNNN` identifiers, control-flow-flattening) and is never referenced from the package's own main entry (index.js is a trivial re-export of plugins/formatjs.js). The stated purpose of the package is an ESLint formatjs configuration; fetching an alternate language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundled blob is unrelated to any ESLint config behavior. The construction gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine on every `npm install`. The package is published under the @ornikar org scope with a repository URL pointing at github.com/ornikar/eslint-configs, consistent with a hijack or squatted republish of the legitimate org's package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
